tssHandcam_toggle.title: TSS Handcam: film with the phone / release
tssHandcam_toggle.desc: Hands the camera to your phone (AcHandCam receiver and phone app running), or gives it back to the game.

tssHandcam_clean.title: TSS Handcam: film clean (no HUD) / release
tssHandcam_clean.desc: Hands the camera to your phone and hides the HUD and all in-game windows for recording; press again to stop filming and bring them back.

tssHandcam_recenter.title: TSS Handcam: recenter
tssHandcam_recenter.desc: Where the phone points now becomes straight ahead; the view stays where it is.

tssHandcam_freeze.title: TSS Handcam: freeze / unfreeze
tssHandcam_freeze.desc: Holds the view while you move yourself; unfreezing carries on from there.

tssHandcam_follow.title: TSS Handcam: ride with my car on/off
tssHandcam_follow.desc: The camera rides with your car (in-car and chase shots) or stays in the world.

tssHandcam_window.title: TSS Handcam: settings window
tssHandcam_window.desc: Shows the phone's status and the camera settings.
